description: Explicitly authorized xUnit skips for the solution-wide .NET test gate (scripts/ci/assert_test_totals.py, used by ci.yml and scripts/dev/test.ps1 -Level 3). A skip is accepted only when the project, the exact TRX test name and the exact skip reason all match one entry; any other skipped, aborted or not-executed test fails the gate. Every entry here is an opt-in real-Vault integration test: it runs only when its developer script provisions a disposable Vault Transit container and exports the variables, and never on hosted CI runners. Adding an entry requires review; a stale entry (test no longer in the results) fails the gate.
